crossRefs.note: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
I thank you, and praise you, you God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me…
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge…
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…

translations.web: Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
translations.bsb: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
translations.asv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
